title.ko: C1 종합: 가정·도치·완곡·연결어를 활용한 논증 에세이
title.en: C1 review: hypotheticals, inversion, hedging and linkers in an argued essay

explain.ko: C1 수준의 논증 에세이는 이 단계에서 배운 여러 도구를 하나의 글로 통합합니다. 논지(This essay argues that ...)를 밝히고, 양면(on the one hand ... on the other)을 제시하며, 반론을 인정(Admittedly, ...)한 뒤 반박(However, ... rebuts this)합니다. 가정법(Had we ...), 도치(Rarely does ...), 헤징(appears to, tend to), 명사화(an increase in ...)를 적절히 섞고, 결론(On balance, ...)에서 논지를 다시 정리합니다. 문체는 격식 있고 정확하게 유지하세요.
explain.en: A C1 argued essay integrates the tools learned at this level. State the thesis (This essay argues that ...), present both sides (on the one hand ... on the other), concede the counter-argument (Admittedly, ...) and rebut it (However, ... rebuts this). Mix hypotheticals (Had we ...), inversion (Rarely does ...), hedging (appears to, tend to) and nominalisation (an increase in ...) appropriately, and restate the thesis in the conclusion (On balance, ...). Keep the style formal and precise.

notes.en: Finally, read the draft aloud and revise.

lines.t: A sophisticated argued essay consists of thesis, evidence, counter-argument, rebuttal and conclusion. Using hypotheticals, inversion and hedging appropriately refines the style. But overly complex structures confuse readers, so balance is needed.

trans.ko: 정교한 논증 에세이는 논지, 근거, 반론, 반박, 결론으로 이루어집니다. 가정법과 도치, 완곡한 표현을 적절히 쓰면 문체가 한층 세련됩니다. 그러나 지나치게 복잡한 구조는 독자를 혼란스럽게 하므로 균형이 필요합니다.

items.passage:
ESSAY SUMMARY
Reading in the digital age
This essay argues that digital devices hinder deep reading. Admittedly, access has improved. However, screen reading may weaken concentration. It is therefore advisable to set aside time deliberately to read paper books.

prompt.ko: 논지·반론·반박·결론을 모두 포함한 정교한 논증 에세이 요약을 4문장으로 써 보세요.
prompt.en: Write a four-sentence summary of a sophisticated argued essay with thesis, counter-argument, rebuttal and conclusion.

task.model: This essay argues that remote working boosts productivity. On the one hand costs fall; on the other, there is concern that collaboration may weaken. However, research shows that online collaboration tools greatly reduce this problem. On balance, companies should adopt flexible working arrangements.

model_trans.ko: 이 에세이는 재택근무가 생산성을 높인다고 주장합니다. 한편으로는 비용이 절감되지만 다른 한편으로는 협업이 약해질 수 있다는 우려가 있습니다. 그러나 온라인 협업 도구가 이 문제를 크게 줄인다는 연구 결과가 있습니다. 종합적으로 볼 때 기업은 유연한 근무 방식을 도입해야 합니다.
model_trans.en: This essay argues that remote working boosts productivity. On the one hand costs fall; on the other, there is concern that collaboration may weaken. However, research shows that online collaboration tools greatly reduce this problem. On balance, companies should adopt flexible working arrangements.
